notes:
OCRelay 1.1.15

CAROTID — A THIRD COLUMN ON THE WORKSHEET IS NO LONGER IGNORED

• Some carotid worksheets print a velocity column headed neither RIGHT nor LEFT ("OTHER"). OCRelay reads right and left only, so anything written under that column was dropped without a word — and because RIGHT still came before LEFT, the existing column-order warning stayed silent.

• When that column has values in it, the review panel now opens and asks which vessel it is, showing exactly what was found, e.g. "OTHER — ICA pk 212, ICA ed 64". Those measurements are still not written to the report; dictate them yourself if they are needed.

• Express will not auto-paste such a study. An empty third column is routine and is ignored as before.

• If you can tell us which vessel that column is for, it can be read properly into the report instead.

WORKSHEET VARIANTS ARE NOW COUNTABLE

• The advisory checks — which columns a worksheet printed, whether the study matched, whether an anatomy row was abnormal — are written to the log as well as shown on screen. Until now a banner reached only whoever was at the screen, so there was no way to tell how often a worksheet variant turns up.

• Check results and column headers only — never a measurement, never an identifier.
